en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2409 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said that the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family) said:
"Whoever embarks on a journey and carries with them a bitter almond stick, and recites this verse:
'When he directed himself toward Madyan, he said, "Perhaps my Lord (azj) will guide me to the right way."'
up to the words of Allah (swt),
'And Allah (swt) is a witness over what we say.' (Surah Al-Qasas 28:22-28),

Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious, will protect them from every harmful beast, every aggressive thief, and every venomous creature until they return to their family and home. Additionally, seventy-seven angels will accompany them, seeking forgiveness for them until they return and set it (the stick) down."
